anchor.section: 3. Per-era notes / e9-counteroffensive-26 (late Jan 2026 – present, Sep 2026)

before.text: DeepState publishes Ukrainian recaptures late, so Vivaldi's May–June 2026 gains show up only in its August–September versions.

before.effect: at least 8 aircraft lost in a week; low-level penetration stopped
before.rationale: When the VKS went low in late February–early March 2022, MANPADS downed at least 8 Su-25/Su-30/Su-34 in a week; low-level penetrating sorties had stopped by April 2022.
Scatterable mines made night resupply through the breach lanes deadly in 2023.

before.effect: Ka-52s suffered disproportionately, often failing to dispense flares
before.rationale: Ka-52s led the gunships and suffered disproportionately; they often failed to dispense flares when engaged by MANPADS.
Rain and fog blinded Ukrainian drones before the Huliaipole infiltration.

before.effect: infiltrators struck at the exit; did not prevent the loss of Sudzha
before.rationale: At Sudzha in March 2025 the Ukrainian General Staff said the pipe infiltration was 'detected in a timely manner' and Air Assault Forces filmed the exit before artillery and HIMARS strikes; Ukraine still withdrew from Sudzha on 12 March 2025 as Rubikon cut its supply lines.

before.effect: up to 20 resupply runs per crew per day
before.rationale: With roads under Rubikon fibre-optic FPV attack, Kazhan bomber drones flew food, water, fuel and grenades around the clock.

before.effect: about 15 FPVs on one robot reported
before.rationale: Tactics catalogue (§3) lists "FPV swarms on UGVs" as a counter to "UGV casevac and resupply".
Tactics catalogue (§3) lists "mud, craters and rivers" as a counter to "UGV casevac and resupply".
Tactics catalogue (§3) lists "drone hunting" as a counter to "Small-group infiltration".

before.effect: only partly effective; lag not given

before.rationale: Tactics catalogue (§3) lists "counter-infiltration strike-search teams" as a counter to "Small-group infiltration".

before.effect: grounds the satellite-linked deep layer; 20–40% effectiveness drop claimed
before.rationale: The February 2026 whitelist cut Russian terminals; the larger drones that struck 20–200 km deep lost their link, and Biletsky claims a 20–40% effectiveness drop.

before.effect: more than 40% of Shahed kills on 24 May 2026; lag not given

before.rationale: At about 500 km/h, jet Gerans are beyond current interceptor drones.

before.effect: mobile fire groups no longer reliable
before.rationale: Jet Gerans complicate the work of mobile fire groups, which Ihnat says can no longer be relied on against them.

before.effect: Russian troops diverted to guard command posts
before.rationale: Reconnaissance mapped nodes whose loss would break control; strikes forced Russia to pull troops back to guard CPs.
